correctness.rationale: A bijective two-time encoding determines all leaf coordinates uniquely. The 16-state mixed transfer trace equals every immediate two-step returning state. Its symbolic determinant reproduces the displayed quartic, and symmetric odd-field potential limits all recurrence to periods 1 and 2. A direct vertex-level simulator exhaustively verifies 19,173,952 initial configurations across seven sizes; finite checks corroborate rather than establish the infinite theorem.

evidence: The general threshold theorem bounds eventual periods and the 2015 voting-time analysis concerns convergence time, not precise periodic counts.
The full-corona two-step absorption identity requires all base sites to have leaves; it does not give half-decoration populations.
broader_coverage.reasoning: General graph-theoretic convergence or an existence of bounded-width transfer techniques does not determine the characteristic polynomial for the explicit mixed constraints. No inspected stronger published formula specializes to the claimed quartic.
